title: Document detached launcher worker diagnostic artifacts and fixed failure tokens
outcome: Document detached launcher worker diagnostic artifacts and fixed failure tokens
acceptance: The launcher usage section documents worker-error-<UUID>.log, the worker-diagnostics: PATH|unavailable stderr locator, and the execution-lock-held, execution-admission-failed, worker-runtime-failed and git-run-directory-unavailable failure tokens, consistent with shipped behavior.

completion.summary: Documented shipped detached launcher failure tokens, exclusive worker diagnostics and their locators, caller/log behavior, foreground scope and conditional executor recovery.
